STS2BALANCEMOD-THE_DIVINE_FOUNTAIN.title: The Divine Fountain
STS2BALANCEMOD-THE_DIVINE_FOUNTAIN.pages: You find a fountain set into the wall. [blue][sine]Glowing water[/sine][/blue] flows endlessly from it.
The [blue][sine]water[/sine][/blue] washes away the [purple]dark weight[/purple] in your deck.
You leave the strange fountain behind.
STS2BALANCEMOD-CLERIC.title: Cleric
STS2BALANCEMOD-CLERIC.pages.INITIAL.desc:
A strange blue humanoid in a golden helmet smiles widely.
"[jitter]Hello friend![/jitter] I am [blue]Cleric[/blue]! Want to try my services?"
STS2BALANCEMOD-CLERIC.pages.INITIAL.opti: Lose [red]{PurifyCost}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Remove a card from your [gold]deck[/gold].
STS2BALANCEMOD-CLERIC.pages.HEAL.descrip: A warm golden light surrounds you and fades.
STS2BALANCEMOD-CLERIC.pages.PURIFY.descr: Cold blue flame surrounds you and fades.
STS2BALANCEMOD-CLERIC.pages.LEAVE.descri: You decide not to trust this [blue]"Cleric"[/blue].
STS2BALANCEMOD-CURSED_TOME.title: Cursed Tome
STS2BALANCEMOD-CURSED_TOME.pages.INITIAL: Inside an abandoned temple, you find a massive open book filled with [purple][jitter]mysterious writing[/jitter][/purple].
The text shifts into words you can understand.
The book speaks of resurrection, curses, and secrets beneath the Spire.
You feel weaker, but the final pages promise power.
You finish the final page and take the dangerous book with you.
STS2BALANCEMOD-CURSED_TOME.pages.STOP.de: You slam the book shut and flee the temple.
STS2BALANCEMOD-AUGMENTER.title: Augmenter
STS2BALANCEMOD-AUGMENTER.pages.INITIAL.d: A suspicious man offers you a dangerous experiment.
STS2BALANCEMOD-AUGMENTER.pages.JAX.descr: He hands you a syringe full of [blue][sine]glowing fluid[/sine][/blue].
STS2BALANCEMOD-AUGMENTER.pages.TRANSFORM: You wake up later. Your deck has changed.
STS2BALANCEMOD-MIND_BLOOM.title: Разум в цвету
Your thoughts connect with something deep inside the Spire.
Fight an Act 1 Boss. Gain [gold]50[/gold] Gold and a [gold]Rare Relic[/gold].
[gold]Upgrade[/gold] all cards. Obtain [gold]Mark of the Bloom[/gold].
Gain [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold. Add [blue]2[/blue] [red]Normality[/red] to your deck.
Heal to full HP. Add [red]Doubt[/red] to your deck.
Your cards bloom with power, but healing is sealed away.
STS2BALANCEMOD-MIND_BLOOM.pages.GOLD.des: Gold pours from nowhere. A price follows.
STS2BALANCEMOD-MIND_BLOOM.pages.HEAL.des: Your wounds close, and doubt remains.
STS2BALANCEMOD-MIND_BLOOM.pages.POST_FIR: Побеждённый враг растворяется в памяти. Впереди ждёт ещё более сильное присутствие.
Принять совершенно неизвестное испытание. За победу получить дополнительно [gold]100[/gold] золота, [gold]редкую реликвию[/gold] и [gold]необычную реликвию[/gold].
STS2BALANCEMOD-MIND_BLOOM.pages.LEAVE_AF: Вы отказываетесь от более глубокого испытания и возвращаетесь с завоёванной добычей.
STS2BALANCEMOD-WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.title: Wheel of Change
STS2BALANCEMOD-WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.INI: A strange figure presents a giant wheel.
STS2BALANCEMOD-WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.REL: The wheel stops on a relic.
STS2BALANCEMOD-WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.CUR: The wheel stops on a curse.
STS2BALANCEMOD-WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.DAM: The wheel stops on a dagger.
STS2BALANCEMOD-WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.RES: Remove a card from your deck.
STS2BALANCEMOD-WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.DAM: A dagger flies from the wheel and strikes you.
STS2BALANCEMOD-TOMB_OF_LORD_RED_MASK.pag: You find a tomb dedicated to a red mask.
The tomb opens and gold spills out.
You offer your gold. The Red Mask falls into your hands.
STS2BALANCEMOD-OLD_BEGGAR.title: Old Beggar
A ragged old beggar reaches toward you as you pass.
"Spare some change, child?"
Lose [red]{GoldCost}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Remove a card from your deck.
STS2BALANCEMOD-OLD_BEGGAR.pages.GAVE_GOL:
The beggar suddenly drops his cloak, revealing [blue]Cleric[/blue]!

"You are a kind soul. Receive my purification!" he shouts.

You are not sure whether he is happy or angry.

"May you do better this time, friend!" he calls after you.
Remove a card from your deck.
STS2BALANCEMOD-OLD_BEGGAR.pages.REMOVE_C: You keep walking, turning his strange words over in your mind.
STS2BALANCEMOD-OLD_BEGGAR.pages.LEAVE.de:
The beggar lowers his head as you pass, muttering:
"You will never accomplish anything... never."
STS2BALANCEMOD-MASKED_BANDITS.title: Бандиты в красных масках
STS2BALANCEMOD-MASKED_BANDITS.pages.INIT:
Three masked bandits block your path!
"[shake]Not so fast![/shake] Hand over your [gold]Gold[/gold] or fight us!"
STS2BALANCEMOD-MASKED_BANDITS.pages.PAID: You hand over your gold and slink away. The bandits laugh as they count their spoils.

Hehehe.. Thanks for the [gold]gold![/gold]
Oh, I love [gold]gold.[/gold] It's so nice.
[sine]shiny[/sine] [sine]shiny[/sine] chits they are!

Hey [blue]Bear,[/blue] hey!
This guy gave us all his [gold]gold![/gold] What a sucker, right?
Get this, I just had to ask nicely. Who knew?!
I certainly didn't! What a chump!

Gang, let's all have a laugh for this wondrous occasion!
[jitter]Hahaah[/jitter]
[jitter]Ho[/jitter] [jitter]HOH[/jitter] [sine]hoho![/sine]
[sine]Hoh![/sine]
BUGSLAYER.pages.LEAVE.description: You decide not to mess with the bugs and walk away.
TINKER_TIME.pages.LEAVE.description: Science often carries risks. You decide to abort the experiment and leave.
THE_FUTURE_OF_POTIONS.pages.LEAVE.descri: You decide to keep your potions and move on.
STS2BALANCEMOD-THE_LIBRARY.title: Великая библиотека
STS2BALANCEMOD-THE_LIBRARY.pages.INITIAL:
Вы находите величественное заброшенное здание.
Табличка у входа гласит: [blue]Великая библиотека[/blue].
Внутри бесконечные ряды свитков и книг.
Вы берете одну и уютно устраиваетесь в кресле.
STS2BALANCEMOD-THE_LIBRARY.pages.READ.de:
История о героине, повелевающей насекомыми.

Занимательно.

Повесть о путникe, застрявшем на далекой планете.

Увлекательно.

Мрачная хроника о подземной структуре.

Тревожно.
STS2BALANCEMOD-THE_LIBRARY.pages.SLEEP.d:
Чтение — для глупцов.
Вы дремлете в удобном кресле.
[sine]Zzz...[/sine][sine]zzz...[/sine][sine]..Zz....[/sine]
Вы просыпаетесь отдохнувшим.
